baseline.baseline: metadata Q4 + RMS no_contract + original cooperative Q6/attention; original classifier; within-block Q6 remains archived

independent_candidates.concurrent: Same kernels, buffers, grids and arithmetic, explicit concurrent encoder; audit all RAW/WAR/WAW dependencies including pre-quantization Q6 scratch-reuse barrier. Pair pilot uses real independent gate/up inputs and CPU outputs.
independent_candidates.fusion: Standalone FFN RMS folded into each supported metadata-Q4 projection workgroup, duplicating exact canonical normalization into dynamic threadgroup storage. No scalar factor moved through dot, no reassociation. Both gate/up must qualify before omitting standalone RMS. Initial domain K divisible256 <=4096, ordinary64-thread groups.

baseline.load: Two one-minute averages<7 at least10 seconds apart before every cohort, bounded180s; before/after readings<7; no background-app changes
baseline.correctness: All raw CPU words, residual/overwrite forms and padded guards; concurrent scratch-reuse tests, repeated model histories; fusion CPU RMS+Q4 boundary tests; any mismatch stops that candidate
baseline.pilot: Three alternating batches x16 resident repetitions; current serial gate/up vs concurrent pair, current RMS-no_contract+Q4 vs fused. Stop >5% summed GPU regression with>=75% fixture losses, or>10% regression on all fixtures. Otherwise9 batches then bounded model screen. No combined candidate.
baseline.full: 3 fresh alternating108-step TinyLlama pairs; full64-step second network numerical check; fresh ordinary controls when screen does not regress; first-pair stop for>10% forward or>15% fresh-worker regression. Below-gate and mixed results remain recorded.
baseline.retention: >=3% median full-history forward reduction,3/3 paired wins,<=2% fresh-worker regression, all lower-load qualifications; extra certificates/regime/recovery before retaining. Archive clear failures and no repeat cohort to seek a pass.
baseline.scope: Research branch only; no main/defaults/push/release/paid compute

driver_correction.failure: Orchestrator looked for cooperative/result.json after mode was renamed candidate; no GPU or numerical failure.
driver_correction.fix: Read candidate directory; resume existing lower-load-qualified CPU-verified pair0 without rerunning or discarding it.

validation_build_correction.reason: CPU reference test was unoptimized and still on first regime-switch after73s; terminated task-owned child to rebuild release tests.

limits: Only these pinned TinyLlama and derived Stories models on Apple M3 Max tested; no large-model/other-GPU claim.
Kernel sums are not whole-model time shares.
First concurrent candidate worker had slower setup and higher total time; all observations retained.
Fusion has kernel and CPU boundary checks only; no full-model integration after its clear regression.
Both candidates compared separately to the same pre-concurrent optimized baseline.
